# SLAP HAPPY LARRY

> A storytelling blog exploring literary analysis, children's literature, and narrative techniques across audiobooks, historical fiction, and visual media.

SLAP HAPPY LARRY is a comprehensive resource for understanding storytelling in multiple forms, with particular expertise in picture books, short story analysis, and historical fiction set in colonial Australia and New Zealand. The site combines literary criticism with practical teaching guides for educators and readers.

## Key Topics

- literary criticism
- storytelling techniques
- children's literature
- picture books
- short story analysis
- women writers
- historical fiction
- audiobooks
- colonial literature
- New Zealand classics
- Alice Munro
- Roger Duvoisin
- literary symbolism
- Australian gold rush
- narrative analysis

## Literary Analysis & Criticism

- [Material by Alice Munro Short Story Analysis](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/material-alice-munro-short-story-analysis): Short story analysis of Alice Munro's 'Material' exploring gender and women writers.
- [I Stand Here Ironing by Tillie Olsen Short Story Analysis](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/i-stand-here-ironing-tillie-olsen-short-story-analysis): Short story analysis of Tillie Olsen's feminist classic with discussion questions.
- [The Symbolism of Tea in Literature](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/the-symbolism-of-tea-in-literature): Literary analysis exploring tea symbolism in relation to colonialism and gender themes.
- [Getting Lost And Storytelling](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/getting-lost-and-storytelling): Literary analysis of getting lost as narrative metaphor for morality in Australian fiction.
- [Disgust](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/disgust): Storytelling technique analysis on how artists elicit disgust through horror and art.

## Picture Books & Children's Literature

- [Teach With Picturebooks](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/picturebook-study): Guide to picture books for teaching with analysis of mentor texts and classroom resources.
- [The Happy Lion by Fatio and Duvoisin](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/happy-lion-fatio-duvoisin-picture-book): Picture book review and analysis of The Happy Lion by Louise Fatio and Roger Duvoisin.
- [Petunia's Christmas by Roger Duvoisin](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/petunias-christmas-roger-duvoisin): Picture book review and analysis of Roger Duvoisin's Petunia's Christmas vintage children's literature.

## Historical Fiction & Classics

- [The Castaways of Disappointment Island](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/the-castaways-of-disappointment-island): Book review and audiobook adaptation analysis of New Zealand classic castaway adventure.
- [Coming Soon: A Lady's Visit to the Gold Diggings of Australia in 1852-53](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/coming-soon-a-ladys-visit-to-the-gold-diggings-of-australia-in-1852-53): Upcoming analysis of Ellen Clacy's memoir about the 1852-53 Australian gold rush era.

## Film & Media Analysis

- [What happens at the end of Triangle of Sadness (2022)?](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/what-happens-at-the-end-triangle-of-sadness-2022): Film analysis and ending explanation of Ruben Östlund's Triangle of Sadness.

## Teaching & Personal Development

- [Overcoming Perfectionism](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/overcoming-perfectionism): Article on perfectionism, fear-based teaching, and child development strategies.
- [Evangelical Christianity: Non-mainstream concepts](https://www.slaphappylarry.com/evangelical-christianity-concepts-beliefs-history): Analysis of evangelical Christianity demographics and trends in New Zealand and Australia.

## Core

- [SLAP HAPPY LARRY](https://www.slaphappylarry.com): Homepage for SLAP HAPPY LARRY, a storytelling blog covering audiobooks, historical fiction, and literary analysis.
